production.benchmark: average manufacturing lead time under 3 days
production.note: Supplier-published network-wide average; not a product-specific SLA or guaranteed maximum.

US.coverage: Sensaria states 80% of U.S. households are reached in 1-2 days by ground shipping.

CA.coverage: Vancouver and Toronto facilities provide 1-2 day transit to the top 5 population centres for over 80% of ground shipments.

AU.coverage: Over 80% of ground shipments to Australia's top 5 population centres arrive in 1-2 days.

EUROPE.coverage: Sensaria publishes regional facilities in the UK and Spain but no numeric Europe-wide transit range.

OTHER.coverage: No verified destination-specific transit range is stored yet.

assumptions: 3-5 business days is an internal planning window, not a Sensaria guarantee.
The temporary profile combines Sensaria's under-3-day average manufacturing benchmark with published 1-2 day ground transit coverage in US/CA/AU.
GO Basic is treated as the standard/basic service for planning only; its exact mapping to specific ground carrier services still needs Sensaria confirmation.
Do not use this provisional profile as a customer-facing guaranteed delivery promise.
